title: Trust Accounting Memo: Amount of the Standing Medicaid Patient Pay Transfer
content:
The standing patient pay transfer from a Resident Trust Fund Accounts account names the patient pay charge of the latest service month on the resident's case under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage (of two charges for the same month, the one recorded first). That month is the named month.

## The amount

The standing patient pay transfer pays the named month's patient pay less the patient pay credit that reaches the named charge and less the payments already naming that charge, never more than the named charge's open balance or the available balance (for a Medicaid representative payee account, the available balance less the personal needs allowance of the resident's Medical Assistance case, because for a Medicaid payee account the personal needs allowance stays in the account) and never below zero, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final amount only.

## The quantities

- **Open balance of the named charge**: the charge less the payments and reductions naming it.
- **Available balance**: the account balance, which is the deposits, interest credits and returns on the account's ledger less its withdrawals, bill transfers and conveyances, less every deposit whose available date is after today, because a check deposit still on hold is not available. The representative payee reduction applies in the Resident Funds Account, Medicaid Representative Payee tier.
- **Named month's patient pay**: the month's patient pay amount, which is the patient pay charge as billed.
- **Patient pay credit that reaches the named charge**: the payments on the case other than those naming the named charge, plus the reductions posted on the other patient pay charges for reasons other than a trueup decrease or a not-eligible month, plus the credited reconciliation amount, plus the credited not-eligible amount, less the amounts of those other charges, never below zero. It is figured on the other charges taken together, so a credit from one month first settles what another month still owes.
- **Credited reconciliation amount**: the trueup decreases posted on the other charges.
- **Credited not-eligible amount**: the not-eligible-month reductions posted on the other charges.

A reduction posted on the named charge itself records the same difference the named month's patient pay already reflects and changes nothing in the credit; it enters only the named charge's open balance.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| named charge (May), as billed | $1184.20 |
| other patient pay charges (March and April) | $2368.40 |
| payments on the case naming those other charges | $2443.40 |
| reductions on the other charges | none |
| credit reaching the named charge: $2443.40 less $2368.40 | $75.00 |
| payments already naming the named charge | none |
| named month's patient pay less the credit | $1109.20 |
| open balance of the named charge | $1184.20 |
| available balance (Medicaid Self-Directed tier) | $1530.66 |
| transfer | **$1109.20** |

With an available balance of only $812.09 the transfer would be $812.09.
